items.heading: Choose the Phd If
items.text: Choose the PhD if you can point to a specific, tested research interest and a specific target role, research scientist, pharma R&D, a government lab, or academia, that genuinely requires the credential. Choose industry if your interest in research is still general, if income timing matters to your family situation, or if the role you actually want does not need a doctorate to get there.

items.heading: The Income Question Is Where
items.text: The income question is where most PhD decisions get made emotionally instead of numerically. Here is what the main funded routes actually pay in India.

items.heading: This Is the Section Most
items.text: This is the section most PhD advice skips. A PhD is now the mandatory minimum qualification for direct-entry assistant professor recruitment at Indian universities, under the UGC rule effective from July 2023.

figures.label: Admissions 2015-16 2 Lakh 2019-20
figures.source: India awards close to 40,000 PhD degrees a year, and total PhD enrolment has crossed two lakh scholars at any given time, up from roughly 1.26 lakh admissions in 2015-16 to over 2 lakh by 2019-20. New sanctioned faculty positions do not expand anywhere near that pace, and each opening is filtered further by NET or SET qualification, university-specific interviews, and reservation and subject-specific quotas.
